reviews.review: While the other comment is probably paid, this game is actually quite good! Although there are some bugs and i also have a skill issue that makes me want to throw my Steam Deck out a window, this is a good game! Also the bugs are probably gml jank. (i code in gml and...yea) The show is also good!
reviews.developer_response: Sorry haven't made time to look into any kind of feed back. You said something about a paid comment? I didn't see any other comment? But I know we haven't paid anyone for any positive feed back, I should know for I don't have any money haha! Please tell me what all bugs you came across so I can go in and try to correct them. This is my very first game and solo developed so I wouldn't be surprised if some were missed. But I do appreciate you saying it's good! I've been hoping players would find joy in this one. Yah this was developed with Game Maker Studio 2. Please contact me and I would love to hear thoughts! Beersy
